calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 9 ORDER BY 2

SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_line, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT 'sale' AS kind, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, (w.web_order_id IS NULL) AS no_dispatch, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'return', r.return_date, false, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, n.kind, n.no_dispatch, count(*) AS n, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,3,4

SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.net_sales) AS rpt_net, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_before, sum(r.returns_net) AS rpt_returns, count(*) AS days
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, o.status, (p.category='ZZ Test') AS test, count(*) AS n, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dl
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE (s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2026-01-10'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT d.fiscal_period, rs.store_id AS return_store, count(*) AS n, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) AS dl
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store fs ON fs.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE fs.store_id=900 AND rs.store_id<>900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT d.fiscal_period, count(*) AS n, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store fs ON fs.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE fs.store_id=900 AND rs.store_id<>900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL
